catalogue_title: Link periods and deformations of Calabi–Yau threefolds with toric singularities
title: Link periods and deformations of Calabi–Yau threefolds with toric singularities
label: Smoothability of Calabi–Yau threefolds

related.label: Local equations for deformations of Calabi–Yau threefolds with del Pezzo cone points

abstract_html: The periods of a relative volume form on the link of an isolated Gorenstein toric threefold singularity embed its semiuniversal deformation germ in the third cohomology of the link. For the homogeneous toric form this embedding is linear in Altmann’s parameters. Multiplication by a holomorphic unit changes the embedding by an automorphism of its source, even over nonreduced bases. The automorphism comes from a common change of the toric height coordinate at all edges of the defining polygon. Let X be a connected normal projective threefold with trivial dualizing sheaf, vanishing irregularity and only such singularities. In the product of the local period images, impose the linear condition that the Poincaré dual link classes sum to zero in the second homology of a projective log resolution. Using a local-to-global lifting theorem for small Artin extensions, we identify the semiuniversal germ of X with the product of this scheme-theoretic linear section and a smooth germ of dimension h1(X,ΘX). We construct a projective example in which a first-order deformation extends to second order and is obstructed at third order.
